WorldUI_Modifiers_RoyalGuard_Desc: Đội Ngự Lâm Quân theo dõi chặt chẽ khu định cư. Mọi hành vi sai phạm hoặc làm tăng Độ Sốt Ruột sẽ chịu phạt gấp đôi.
WorldUI_Modifiers_RoyalGuard_Name: Sự Giám Sát Của Ngự Lâm Quân
WorldUI_Modifiers_StormModifiers_Desc: Các yếu tố thời tiết khắc nghiệt ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến quy tắc ván chơi.
WorldUI_Modifiers_Wilderness_Desc: Khu vực hoang dã chưa từng được thám hiểm. Chi phí mở vùng rừng nguy hiểm tăng thêm 50%.
WorldUI_Town_Rename_Prompt: Nhập tên mới cho khu định cư:
WorldUI_CycleEnd_Confirmation: Bạn có chắc chắn muốn kết thúc Chu Kỳ Bão Blight hiện tại không?
WorldUI_CustomGame_Desc: Thiết lập quy tắc, độ khó và tài nguyên khởi đầu theo ý muốn.
WorldUI_DailyChallenge_Desc: Hoàn thành ván chơi với các điều kiện chỉnh sửa ngẫu nhiên để nhận phần thưởng Hoàng Thành.
WorldUI_SealContract_Desc: Yêu cầu cần đạt để thực hiện rèn lại Phong Ấn Cổ Đại.
WorldUI_TownName_32: Thành Phố Hoàng Thành Tro Tàn
News_1_10_Header: Cập Nhật Phiên Bản 1.10 - Phong Ấn Mới & Cân Bằng
News_1_10_Desc: Khám phá các thử thách mới, hệ thống hợp đồng phong ấn cải tiến và nhiều cập nhật cân bằng lối chơi.
Deed_WinWithAllNeeds_Objective: Đảm bảo tất cả dân làng có đầy đủ 100% các nhu cầu cùng một lúc. Yêu cầu ít nhất 3 chủng tộc cùng sống trong khu định cư. (Nhu cầu đáp ứng trong nhà cộng đồng không được tính).
Deed_WinWithNoImpatience_Objective: Giành chiến thắng ván chơi mà không để thanh Độ Sốt Ruột của Nữ Hoàng tăng lên quá 1 điểm.
Deed_WinWithNoDying_Objective: Giành chiến thắng ván chơi ở độ khó Quan Tổng Đốc trở lên mà không có bất kỳ dân làng nào tử trận hoặc bỏ trốn.
Deed_WinHighPrestige_Objective: Giành chiến thắng ván chơi ở độ khó Prestige 20.
Deed_BuildAllServices_Objective: Xây dựng và vận hành tất cả các loại công trình dịch vụ trong cùng một khu định cư.
Deed_TradeMaster_Objective: Giao dịch thành công hàng hóa trị giá 500 Hổ Phách qua các tuyến thương mại liên đô thị.
Deed_BlightrotExterminator_Objective: Thiêu hủy tổng cộng 100 U Độc Blightrot bằng Bình Xịt Lửa trong các mùa bão.
WorldUI_ModifierPickPopup_BlockedByBiome: This modifier is blocked by a nearby biome.
WorldUI_ModifierPickPopup_BlockedByOther: This modifier is blocked by another modifier on one of the adjacent fields.
WorldUI_ModifierRewardsPopup_Desc: "I salute you for your achievements, Viceroy! Many who have entered these lands never came back. As is tradition, you can petition the Crown for a resupply."
WorldUI_ModifierRewardsPopup_Footer: This choice has to be made before starting a new expedition.
WorldUI_SealContracts_SlotTooltip_Defaul: This Seal ({0}) can be found {1} fields from the Citadel. It requires {2} and must be attempted on {3} difficulty or higher.

WorldUI_SealContracts_Tooltip_Desc: Contracts allow you to choose which Seals will be assigned to you during the next Cycle.
WorldUI_SealFragments_Description: Legend says that the seals can never be broken, but these shards tell a different story. Fragments are needed to venture into the Sealed Forest at the end of every cycle to reforge the ancient seal. Any leftovers must be sold back to the Crown.
WorldUI_WorldTutorialsHUD_DecisionPopup_: You are about to begin the tutorial scenario: {0}. You can leave the tutorial and return to the world map at any time.
WorldUI_WorldTutorialsHUD_Desc: Here you can replay tutorial missions and unlock additional scenarios that will explain the more complex aspects of the game. Tutorial towns have no effect on the Blightstorm Cycle and don't appear on the World Map, but will grant you some resources for completion.
GameUI_FishingHutPanel_NearbyPonds_Toolt: Fishing pond resources are not stored at the Fishing Hut. Instead, they are collected in a net, and transported to a warehouse only once the entire pond has been depleted.
MenuUI_Options_Game_Save Tracked Goods_T: If this option is on, tracked goods settings will be saved between settlements.
GameUI_BuildingPanel_HaulerPriorities_To: Set hauler priorities and choose whether they carry ingredients, products, or both. By default, haulers prioritize products over ingredients. Buildings with higher priority are serviced first, while those with the same priority are treated equally. Priorities are global for all haulers in the settlement.

News_Update1_10_Content: This update introduces three new World Map modifiers (including one where you play with four species), an overhaul of the hauler system (pun intended), new deeds, and a wide range of UI improvements inspired by community feedback.
News_Update1_10_Content_Long: This update introduces three new World Map modifiers (including one where you play with four species), an overhaul of the hauler system (pun intended), new deeds, and a wide range of UI improvements inspired by community feedback.
Deed_WorldEvent_WinWithoutLeaving_Object: Win a game with no villagers leaving or being exiled.
Deed_GhostTownStag_Generic_Objective: Catch or release the Spectral Treasure Stag within the time limit and complete the settlement.

Homeless Frogs

Effect_BlightBomb_Blightrot_Desc: The Blight Bomb explosion will spawn {0} Blightrot Cysts. All dormant cysts will activate and start to corrupt the Ancient Hearth.
ModifierEffect_4Races_Desc: A revered site commemorating the peace forged after the Great Civil War. Your settlement can have four species at once, but you cannot choose newcomer groups. Each Drizzle season, you gain {0} random villager for each discovered glade (including the starting glade).
ModifierEffect_RandomSeasonDuration_Desc: An ominous structure made from a material not known to contemporary scholars. Clouds swirl around the tip of this giant tower. Seasons have random durations.
ModifierEffect_OneInitialVillagerPerRace: By royal decree, this land belongs to the Merchant Guild, and only its appointed representatives may settle here. You begin with a single villager per species. Additional villagers from Embarkation Bonuses are not granted.
Deed_WinWithAllNeeds_4Races_Desc: Ensure all villagers have all their needs fulfilled simultaneously while having four species in one settlement. Needs met in the Commons don’t count.
WorldUI_CustomGames_Races_Tooltip_Desc: Settlements have three species by default. In Training Expeditions, you can choose up to four. Unselected species are filled randomly (up to three total). To play with four, you must select them manually.
Deed_Year1Dangerous_Objective: Win after discovering {0} Dangerous Glades before the end of Year {1}, on {2} difficulty (or higher).
MetaReward_Home_BoardGame_Desc: A finely carved figurine from a beloved Stormwalker board game. A common sight in remote outposts, where crews gather around it during the fiercest Storms.
Reward_HousesforBreak_Altar_Desc: All houses have room for {0} more villager (up to a maximum of 16 from all housing capacity bonuses), and the time between breaks for workers increases by {1}.
Reward_HousesforBreak_Desc: All houses have room for {0} more villager (up to a maximum of 16 from all housing capacity bonuses).
Effect_HubsForHousingSpots_Altar_Desc: For every {0} completed trade routes, all houses will have room for one more person (up to a maximum of 16 from all housing capacity bonuses).
BuildingPerk_HousesBonusCapacity_Desc: A strategically built wall can do wonders. This house gains space for 1 additional villager (up to a maximum of 16 from all housing capacity bonuses).
Effect_HubsForHousingSpots_Desc: For every {0} completed trade routes, all houses will have room for one more person (up to a maximum of 16 from all housing capacity bonuses).
Reward_SeasonalEffect_WarmWelcome_Desc: Reputation generated through high Resolve grows {0} faster.
